tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: New off-campus apartment; heating system is not working properly. Write an email to Mr. Smith.
bullets: Describe the issue with the heating system.
Explain how the problem is affecting your daily life.
Suggest a resolution for the problem.
tasks.subject: Urgent: Heating System Not Working Properly
